name: Kaspar Hübener
headline: Mobile Games | Strategy & Operations | People & Tech | ex-Wooga | Alumn of CDTM & TUM
summary:
I help you build, implement, operate {products | teams | the next big thing}. I feel home where ideas and reality meet.

I am a professional with 12+ years in building and operating highly successful teams. Previously in mobile games incl. 100+ people teams, millions of players and revenue.

- Strategy co-pilot who listens to priorities, pitfalls and potential problems.
- Makes sure team and stakeholders are aligned around roadmap and communication is sound
- Able to lead with empathy.
- Ready to go into technical details where needed.
- Teamplayer and low ego despite this bullish list. Fun to work with.

Currently seeking a role where I can drive growth with talented peers in a purpose-driven environment.

positions.title: Director of Production
positions.description:
- Scaled the team to 120+ people, enabling a multi-year strategic planning horizon and supporting long-term product growth.
- Designed and implemented a successful org structure, contributing to over €1bn in revenue to date.
- Shaped multi-year product strategy, by providing risk and feasibility insights across initiatives.
- Forecasted team capacity and outsourcing budgets exceeding €4m, ensuring delivery across five parallel teams.
- Mentored and coached emerging leaders, strengthening leadership capabilities across the organization.
- Drove cross-discipline workshops (with 10 to 25 key participants) to align teams and accelerate decision- making
- Led internal initiatives such as game jams and team activities to foster creativity and team cohesion.

positions.title: Lead Producer
positions.description:
- Key contributor in June’s Journey becoming Wooga’s biggest success, generating €100m+ in annual revenue and attracting acquisition interest.
- Delivered weekly content and major features to millions of players in 20+ languages & 3 app stores, driving rapid growth
- Rolled out complex social features (leagues, tournaments, chat) to foster a vibrant player community, deepen engagement, and fuel organic growth.
- Scaled the team to 70+ people by introducing parallel development teams and domain specialists, boosting focus and execution.
- Established resilient development processes, empowering teams with ownership and creating company-wide best practices, especially critical during the pandemic.
- Led the production discipline, supporting delivery and team health across multiple initiatives.

positions.title: Producer
positions.description:
- Built the post-launch roadmap for successful live operations, leading to strong annual growth
- Aligned stakeholders about priorities and dependencies
- Enabled customer support and marketing teams through processes and technical expertise

positions.title: Producer
positions.description:
- Prototyped feasibility of content creation in Unity during pre-production for an undisclosed new puzzle title
- Built budget plans, feature roadmap, and estimations before entering production phase
- The cost estimates ultimately led to proposing to stop the project

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description:
- Created the first time user experience and game balancing for a round-based strategy title
- Successfully launched the game without marketing budget and generated seven-digit revenues
- Helped transitioning the project and technology to new owner Innogames, Hamburg

positions.title: Web Developer & Co-Founder
positions.description:
- Co-founded mountix.com, a social network for mountaineers.
- The mission was to make planning, communication, and exploration of outdoor activities easier
- Involved during inception. Co-developed the platform with Ruby on Rails.
- Designed the front end for web and mobile. Orchestrated efforts among developers
- The company was acquired by Bruckmann Verlag (Bergsteiger) in 2016
and had ca. 20k active users around that time
